items.evidence: One-half of the target 2015 LTIP award is earned based on the Company's average ROE over the three-year performance period (MS Average ROE).
The other half of the target 2015 LTIP award is earned based on the Company's TSR over the three-year period (MS TSR) relative to the TSR of the S&P 500 Financials Index
ROE, ex-DVA is one of the measures the CMDS Committee utilizes to evaluate the Company's financial performance.
